MP.note: Replaces the XLP (consumer-staples) proxy, which had no economic relationship to a rare-earth miner (G47). Both candidates measured on 22 daily returns: XME edges REMX on raw correlation (0.795 vs 0.764) but the 0.03 gap is noise at n=22, so the tiebreak is conceptual -- REMX isolates rare-earth-specific moves, which is what peer-relative strength is actually asking, whereas XME would conflate 'rare earths are hot' with 'MP is strong'. CAVEAT: MP is itself a sizeable REMX constituent, so MP-vs-REMX is partly MP-vs-itself and will understate genuine outperformance -- same self-inclusion issue as DRAM/MU in this book. Switch to XME if that dampening ever masks a real signal.
